name: skillars-e2e
description: Skillars adapter for the Pitchside UI test framework: routes, auth, factories, screens and every spec.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:parallel; parallel=$?; npm run test:e2e:serial; serial=$?; [ $parallel -eq 0 ] && [ $serial -eq 0 ]
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose -p skillars-e2e -f stack/docker-compose.e2e.yml logs --no-color app
